observations.body: Paul asks disciples about receiving the Holy Spirit, explains John’s baptism and Jesus, baptizes them, lays hands on them, and they speak languages and prophesy.
observations.label: Ephesian disciples receive the Spirit, speak languages, and prophesy

observations.body: The passage presents Teaching and baptism before laying on hands as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Teaching and baptism before laying on hands

observations.body: The passage places Languages and prophecy beside Teaching and baptism before laying on hands.
observations.label: Languages and prophecy

payload.posture: Read Acts 19:1–7 as one movement in Pentecost, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states paul asks disciples about receiving the Holy Spirit, explains John’s baptism and Jesus, baptizes them, lays hands on them, and they speak languages and prophesy. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Pentecost.
payload.title: Ephesian disciples receive the Spirit, speak languages, and prophesy
